Vendored, unmodified: the FINAL wave-1 coordinator, for the offline suites of the RP adapters
(tests/test_compat_inventory.py, test_compat_wallet.py, test_compat_economy.py, test_a9_cargo.py,
test_compat_jobs.py).

Origin: Open77 repository, resources/system/open77_transactions, branch wi/a13-coordinator,
commit 697e9e2f0045587e21907c95716a38cc5089a8a1 (2026-10-12, "feat(a13): open77_transactions
coordinator, wave 1 (opt-in resource)"), merged into feat/world-interaction (7daad67c). Read from
the worktree C:\Games\cyberm\wt-wi-a13b. The resource's own tests/ folder is not copied.

Git blob ids (LF content), equal to `git rev-parse 697e9e2f:resources/system/open77_transactions/<file>`:

How the suites run it: the REAL server scripts, in manifest order, server/main.lua included (its
exports, tunables, work queue, gate, events and subject provider). The only test seam is
tests/compat/txshim.lua, loaded just before server/main.lua: it hands the test's in-memory store
(server/memory_store.lua, with its fault injection) to main.lua in place of the MySQL bridge
(Open77TxSql.newStore) and of the KVP file (Open77TxKvpStore.new), and records the coordinator
object for assertions. Hosts: tests/compat/txsandbox.lua on the single-resource fakehost.lua (B2,
B4, A9), multihost.lua as a resource of its own (B3).

To run the suites against another copy (a newer coordinator), set OP77_TX_DIR to its
resources/system/open77_transactions folder. Do not edit these files: refresh them from the origin
and update the commit and the blob ids above (tests/test_compat_wallet.py checks them).
